expectations.text: All three entities (Author, Book, Publisher) are extracted into detected-entities.json as separate entries with table_names matching the @Entity('...') first arg (e.g., 'authors', 'books', 'publishers')
expectations.evidence: detected-entities.json has 3 entities: Author→authors, Book→books, Publisher→publishers. All class_names + table_names match the @Entity('...') decorator arguments.

expectations.text: Each @OneToMany(() => Book, ...) and @ManyToOne(() => Author, ...) produces a relationship with target_entity resolved from the arrow-function call argument — never blank, never the literal string 'Book'/'Author' (the resolver must dereference to the imported class)
expectations.evidence: All 3 relationships have target_entity='' (empty). Root cause: _resolveRelationshipTarget in extractor.ts does not handle TypeORM's `() => ClassName` arrow-function syntax — leading `(` breaks the existing call-arg regex; no fallback pattern matches. Genuine code gap. Fix: add `/^\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=>\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*[,)]/` before the existing patterns. iter-8 candidate T3.

expectations.text: Relationship type matches the decorator name (one_to_many for @OneToMany, many_to_one for @ManyToOne, one_to_one for @OneToOne)
expectations.evidence: detected-entities.json: Author.@OneToMany→one_to_many, Book.@ManyToOne→many_to_one, Book.@OneToOne→one_to_one. All 3 decorator-to-type mappings correct.

expectations.text: Generated database-mapping.md frontmatter has type='entity' and orm_profile='typeorm'
expectations.evidence: database-mapping.md frontmatter contains type: entity and orm_profile: typeorm.

expectations.text: Mermaid erDiagram contains nodes for all three table names and at least two edges (authors-books and books-publishers, or whatever the fixture declares) using cardinality glyphs that match the decorator (||--o{ for one_to_many, }o--|| for many_to_one)
expectations.evidence: 3 nodes declared (authors, books, publishers). 2 edges present but target synthetic stubs (authors_rel, books_rel) instead of real tables — downstream of A2 (empty target_entity). Required edges authors↔books and books↔publishers absent. publishers node is isolated. Cardinality ||--o{ appears (correct for one_to_many) but on wrong target.

expectations.text: Any external target referenced via @ManyToOne whose class file is NOT in the fixture set is emitted as a _external stub before the edge — never an edge to an undeclared node
expectations.evidence: All fixture targets are in-scope (Author/Book/Publisher), so the _external path isn't exercised. BUT the 'never an edge to an undeclared node' clause is violated: edges go to `authors_rel` and `books_rel` which are not declared as entity blocks and not _external stubs. The `_rel` fallback is a distinct code path from `_external`, and it produces phantom targets. Downstream of A2.

expectations.text: mermaid_lint.js passes on the generated page
expectations.evidence: mermaid_lint.js --page ... → [] (exit 0). Mermaid block is syntactically valid even though node references are semantically incorrect.

suggestions.assertion: Each @OneToMany(() => Book, ...) and @ManyToOne(() => Author, ...) produces a relationship with target_entity resolved
suggestions.reason: Code fix (iter-8 T3): _resolveRelationshipTarget in extractor.ts needs to handle TypeORM's arrow-function syntax. The pattern `() => ClassName` is distinct from SQLAlchemy's `relationship('Name')` (string arg) and JPA's generic-type resolution. Concrete fix: regex `^\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=>\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*[,)]`. Once this lands, A5 + A6 collapse to correct behavior (same root cause as Prisma P1 but different syntax).

suggestions.assertion: Any external target referenced via @ManyToOne whose class file is NOT in the fixture set is emitted as a _external stub before the edge — never an edge to an undeclared node
suggestions.reason: Two issues: (1) the fixture doesn't exercise @_external stubs (all targets are in-scope), so consider adding a 4th stub-only typeorm fixture file. (2) The `_rel` fallback in output.ts should probably be replaced with an `_external` stub when target_entity is empty, to honor the 'never edge to undeclared node' invariant. Candidate iter-8 fix: merge the _rel and _external code paths into one 'emit stub-or-fail' helper.

eval_feedback.overall: 4/7 pass. TypeORM detection correctly identifies decorators + table names + relationship types, but fails to resolve target_entity from arrow-function syntax. All 3 failures trace to the same root cause (T3). Mermaid edges + external-stub invariant both collapse downstream of target_entity resolution — fixing T3 should recover at least 2 of the 3 failures.
